subject: Reasoning
description: Generation tracking, in-law relations, multi-step pointing puzzles

questions.stem: Pointing to a man, a woman said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: 'The only daughter of my mother' = the woman herself. So 'his mother' = the woman → she is the man's mother. Distractor 1 = aunt (would be 'His mother is my sister'). Distractor 3 = sister (different chain). Distractor 4 = daughter (reversed direction).
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: If A is the brother of B; B is the sister of C; C is the father of D, then D is A's:

options.option_text: Niece of A through brother B's family
Daughter of A through her own family
Cousin of A through some other branch

questions.explanation: A and B share parents (siblings). B and C are also siblings (B sister of C). So A and C are siblings. C is father of D → D is A's nephew/niece. Gender of D not specified, so 'nephew or niece' is the correct answer. Distractor 1 — only correct if D is female. Distractors 3, 4 wrong.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a girl, Anil said, 'She is the daughter of my mother's only son.' How is the girl related to Anil?
questions.explanation: 'My mother's only son' = Anil himself. 'Daughter of Anil' = Anil's daughter. Distractor 1 (sister) = if it were 'father's daughter'. Distractor 3 (niece) = if 'mother's son's daughter' included another sibling. Distractor 4 (cousin) = different chain.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Sita said, 'Hari's mother is the only daughter-in-law of my mother.' How is Hari related to Sita?
questions.explanation: Sita's mother's 'only daughter-in-law' = the wife of Sita's only brother, OR Sita herself if she is married into another family. Standard simpler reading: if Sita is married, the 'only daughter-in-law of my (own) mother' refers to Sita herself. Hari's mother = Sita → Hari is Sita's son. Distractor 1, 3, 4 don't fit the chain.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a photograph, Vijay said, 'He is the son of my father's only sister.' How is the man in the photograph related to Vijay?

options.option_text: Brother of Vijay through both parents

questions.explanation: 'My father's only sister' = paternal aunt (bua). Her son = paternal aunt's son = Vijay's cousin (paternal side). Distractor 1 = brother (would need same parents). Distractors 2 and 3 are maternal-side cousins, but here we have paternal.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Manish said to Renu, 'Your mother's husband's sister is my aunt.' How is Manish related to Renu?
questions.explanation: Renu's mother's husband = Renu's father. His sister = Renu's aunt (paternal side). She is Manish's aunt too → Manish + Renu share paternal aunt → Manish is Renu's COUSIN.

questions.stem: If X is the brother of the SON of Y's son, how is X related to Y?

options.option_text: Great-grandson of Y in this scenario
Grandson of Y in this scenario
Brother of Y in this scenario
Cousin of Y in this scenario

questions.explanation: Y's son's son = Y's grandson. X is BROTHER of that grandson → X has the same parent (Y's son) → X is also Y's grandson. Distractor 1 = wrong (would need an additional generation). Distractor 3 = brother (wrong, X is in younger generation). Distractor 4 = cousin (wrong relation type).
